job.email_subject: Application: React JS / PWA role – Kranti Chavan
job.email_body:
Dear Muskaan Khatoon,

I saw your React JS / PWA post – I bring 5+ years of headless commerce, including APIs built for PWA frontends at Shell. What I bring in concrete terms:

– RESTful and OCC APIs for PWA and headless storefronts
– JavaScript, responsive design and storefront customization
– CI/CD deployment cycles and code reviews

This lets me take on real responsibility in your team from day one. I live in Karlsruhe, hold a valid German work permit and can start on 16 December 2026. My CV and cover letter are attached, and I am happy to walk you through my projects in detail. Could we set up a short 15-minute call in the next few days? I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards
Kranti Chavan

tailoring.headline: Frontend-Focused Commerce Developer | PWA Integration, JavaScript & Headless APIs
tailoring.summary: Commerce developer with 5+ years on enterprise headless storefronts (SAP Commerce Cloud / Hybris) for Rockwell Automation and Shell. Built RESTful APIs and OCC web services for headless commerce integrations and Progressive Web Application (PWA) frontends, worked with JavaScript, responsive design and storefront customization, and implemented frontend and backend functionality for catalog, pricing and customer data. Strong in Java and Spring Boot, Git and CI/CD deployment cycles, code reviews and AI-assisted development in agile, international teams.
tailoring.why_company: Your post focuses on PWA work, and my strongest frontend-related experience is exactly the integration of PWA storefronts with commerce APIs. I want to bring that end-to-end view of storefront and backend to a team building fast, modern commerce experiences. My combination of hands-on platform depth and close work with business teams is exactly what I want to put to work for you.
